title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: cred ships realistic toy source documents minimal Zotero SQLite inst/extdata/:
code: inst/extdata/ ├── zotero.sqlite              # 3 items: smith2020, jones2019, doe2021 (no attachment) └── storage/     ├── TOYPDF1/salmon_habitat.pdf      # Smith et al. 2020 — 4 paragraphs     └── TOYDOC1/beaver_ecology.docx     # Jones 2019 — 4 paragraphs library(cred)  toy_zotero_dir <- system.file("extdata", package = "cred")

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_aud_write() scans chapter Rmd files (names beginning four digits), extracts every @citekey surrounding sentence paraphrase, writes CSV scaffold blank verified, quote, notes columns. toy Rmd files reflect common patterns scientific reports: specific statistics, process findings, one claim source support. floodplain growth claim habitat chapter cites smith2020SalmonHabitat, PDF’s paragraph 4 covers large woody debris — floodplain rearing. mismatch deliberate: produces no_match outcome want demonstrate. sentence written single line crd_aud_write() captures full paraphrase context. Nine rows across two chapters. verified column blank — matching happened yet.
code: rmd_dir    <- tempfile("rmd_") audit_file <- tempfile("audit_", fileext = ".csv") dir.create(rmd_dir)  # Chapter 1 — habitat quality: 4 claims, 3 citation keys # smith2020 has a PDF attachment; doe2021 has metadata only (no PDF) # Each sentence is on one line so crd_aud_write() captures the full paraphrase. writeLines(c(   "# Habitat Quality {#habitat}",   "",   "Reaches where spawning substrate embeddedness exceeded 25% had egg-to-fry survival rates 62% lower than adjacent low-embeddedness sites, making fine sediment the dominant limiting factor for chinook reproduction [@smith2020SalmonHabitat].",   "",   "Removal of riparian conifers within 30 m of the bankfull channel raised daily maximum summer stream temperatures by an average of 4.2 degrees Celsius compared to unlogged reference reaches, exceeding the upper thermal tolerance of juvenile chinook during late-summer rearing [@smith2020SalmonHabitat].",   "",   "Fish passage assessments at 1,200 road-stream crossings found that 38% were rated as full or partial barriers to adult chinook migration, primarily due to culverts with outlet drops exceeding 15 cm [@smith2020SalmonHabitat].",   "",   "Floodplain rearing habitat supports juvenile chinook growth rates substantially higher than mainstem conditions during high-flow events [@smith2020SalmonHabitat].",   "",   "Stream temperature governs the spatial distribution of juvenile salmon and limits rearing area during summer low flows [@doe2021NoFile]." ), file.path(rmd_dir, "0100-habitat.Rmd"))  # Chapter 2 — beaver ecology: 4 claims, all jones2019 (docx attachment) writeLines(c(   "# Beaver Ecology {#beaver}",   "",   "Electrofishing surveys recorded juvenile salmonid densities 3.4 times higher in beaver pond habitat than in adjacent free-flowing reaches, with slow-water refuges providing shelter from winter spates while maintaining access to benthic invertebrate prey [@jones2019BeaverEcology].",   "",   "Experimental reintroduction of beavers to an incised stream reach reduced peak daily flows by 31% during late-season storm events and extended summer baseflow duration by five weeks due to increased groundwater storage in pond sediments [@jones2019BeaverEcology].",   "",   "Archival records indicate that beaver pond habitat declined by approximately 60% between 1850 and 1950 due to commercial trapping pressure, reducing overwinter rearing capacity for juvenile salmonids [@jones2019BeaverEcology].",   "",   "Juvenile chinook tagged in the main channel were detected in floodplain side channels during high-flow events, where they remained for 12 to 34 days and achieved growth rates 40% higher than fish remaining in the mainstem [@jones2019BeaverEcology]." ), file.path(rmd_dir, "0200-beaver.Rmd"))  crd_aud_write(rmd_dir = rmd_dir, out_file = audit_file) #> Scanning: 0100-habitat.Rmd #> Scanning: 0200-beaver.Rmd #> Wrote 9 rows to /tmp/RtmpZL446Z/audit_1c7f731ed8d8.csv

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: crd_aud_verify_all() loads source document , every unverified row matching key scores paragraphs/pages paraphrase using token overlap. fills: quote — best-matching passage source page_or_section — paragraph index (docx) page number (pdf) verified — "auto" score ≥ min_score; "no_match" threshold Reading outcomes: auto (yellow) — passage found source scoring threshold. quote column shows source actually says. job: read , decide match. no_match (light green) — source file exists, paragraph scored threshold. happens report’s phrasing different source text. needs manual verification. NA (grey) — source file attached Zotero. Nothing match . Notice row 4: floodplain growth claim ("Floodplain rearing habitat supports juvenile growth rates...") cites smith2020SalmonHabitat, PDF covers large woody debris paragraph 4 — floodplain rearing. source simply doesn’t contain claim. exactly kind mismatch cred designed surface.
code: crd_aud_verify_all(   audit_file = audit_file,   sources    = sources ) #> [1/2] Loading source for jones2019BeaverEcology (docx) ... #> Filling 4 rows for jones2019BeaverEcology ... #> Done — 4 filled, 0 no_match #> [2/2] Loading source for smith2020SalmonHabitat (pdf) ... #> Filling 4 rows for smith2020SalmonHabitat ... #> Done — 4 filled, 0 no_match

code: library(cred)  # ── One-time setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Generate the audit CSV from project root (chapter Rmd files only) crd_aud_write(rmd_dir = ".", out_file = "background/citation_audit.csv")  # ── After adding new Rmd content ──────────────────────────────────────────── # Merge new citations without losing manual edits crd_aud_upd("background/citation_audit.csv")  # ── Auto-fill from Zotero ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Zotero must be open for BBT citation keys; not needed for the SQLite lookup crd_aud_verify_all("background/citation_audit.csv")  # ── Check progress ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── crd_aud_summary("background/citation_audit.csv")  # ── Review session ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # Sort auto rows to the top, open the review app crd_aud_sort("background/citation_audit.csv", by = "status") crd_aud_review("background/citation_audit.csv")  # ── Restore report order when done ───────────────────────────────────────── crd_aud_sort("background/citation_audit.csv", by = "report")

title: Citation Audit Workflow
text: token scoring approach simple fast: Strip @citekey markers markdown punctuation paraphrase Split tokens (≥ 4 characters) Score paragraph/page: proportion query tokens found passage Accept top-scoring passage score ≥ min_score (default 0.2) Lower min_score cast wider net cost weaker matches; raise require stricter agreement. default 0.2 (20% token overlap) works well specific factual claims numbers key terms.

Citation Review and Evidence Documentation
text: 1. Generate audit CSV — one row per citation, surrounding sentence paraphrase: 2. Auto-fill quotes source documents — queries local Zotero database PDF/docx attachments, searches one best-matching passage, fills quote, page_or_section, verified = "auto": 3. Check progress — see status breakdown PDFs attach Zotero unlock rows: 4. Sort review session — auto rows (quotes ready check) first, NA rows (source file) last: 5. Launch review app — paraphrase quote side side, dropdown set verified, saves back CSV: 6. Restore report order done:

text: character(1) trimmed sentence fragment, full line fragment uninformative.

title: Extract the sentence(s) containing a specific citation key — crd_sent_ext_key
text: Split rules (applied outside [...] citation bracket groups): . [Capital] — period followed capital letter, excluding common abbreviations (et al., Dr., Mr., St.). . @key — period followed narrative citation, sentences form @author documented... correctly isolated. lookahead (?![^[]*\]) prevents splitting inside [@k1; @k2] checking ] reachable without first crossing [.

title: Extract the sentence(s) containing a specific citation key — crd_sent_ext_key
code: line <- paste(   "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y.",   "@brown2022 extended the finding." ) crd_sent_ext_key(line, "jones2021") #> [1] "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y." crd_sent_ext_key(line, "brown2022") #> [1] "@smith2020 documented X; @jones2021 confirmed Y. @brown2022 extended the finding."
